title: Varenicline for alcohol use disorder, other readings of two ambiguous posted values
intro: The same trials and classification as varenicline_aud.json, with the two ambiguous posted values read the other way, both of which favour the pre-registered hypothesis: NCT00705523's posted 'SD's taken as SDs, and NCT02859142's 'change from baseline' values taken as reductions (more is better). A sensitivity bound, not the main analysis.
